description: This Java source file defines the OutboundSignalFactory class, which provides static factory methods for creating various types of OutboundSignal instances used within the connectivity services component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating new outbound signals, wrapping existing signals with additional context, creating multi-mapped signals, and generating signals from JSON data.

classes.name: OutboundSignalFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating various OutboundSignal instances, including new signals, wrapped signals, multi-mapped signals, and signals created from JSON data.

methods.name: newOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an OutboundSignal containing a Signal and a list of Targets where the Signal should be delivered.

methods.name: newMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an OutboundSignal that wraps an existing OutboundSignal and is aware of the ExternalMessage associated with it.

methods.name: newMultiMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates a MultiMappedOutboundSignal from a non-empty list of mapped outbound signals, with an optional sender actor.

methods.name: newMappableOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an OutboundSignal that uses a common PayloadMapping for all targets.

methods.name: outboundSignalFromJson
methods.description: Returns an OutboundSignal constructed from the given JSON object, using specified mapping strategies.
